claim_boundary: Primary-source reproduction / mechanism audit only. No ranking, superiority, or RAKL improvement claim.

exclude_if: Only a prose approximation of a named system without executable official code
Admitted after any Epoch-1 evaluated outcome exists (requires new epoch)
include_if: Named in #407 initial systems list OR admitted before competitor-set freeze under this rule
Has an identifiable primary paper and/or official public code artifact
selection_rule.strawman_policy: FORBIDDEN — do not build a clone and name it after the competitor
